mapper.select: SELECT country_name_cn AS name,count(*) AS orderCount FROM dmp_order_info WHERE country_name_cn!=null or country_name_cn!='' GROUP BY country_name_cn

SELECT round(SUM ( i.sell_price * i.quantity * i.currency_rate ) / 10000, 4 ) AS sales, i.sku_no AS flagNo FROM dmp_order_item i LEFT JOIN dmp_order_info o ON i.order_id = o.ID WHERE new_sign = 0 GROUP BY i.sku_no ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT round(SUM ( i.sell_price * i.quantity * i.currency_rate ) / 10000, 4 ) AS sales, i.sku_no AS flagNo FROM dmp_order_item i LEFT JOIN dmp_order_info o ON i.order_id = o.ID WHERE new_sign = 1 GROUP BY i.sku_no ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT o.shop_no,round( SUM ( o.order_fee ) / 10000, 4 ) AS sales FROM dmp_order_info o GROUP BY o.shop_no
